Word, Excel, Outlook et les autres appli: Word, Excel, Outlook and the other Windows apps are listed in the Applications menu, like Linux apps. When you first open an app, Windows starts automatically (about thirty seconds); later launches are almost instant. Each Windows window is displayed as a desktop window, with its icon in the dock.
Chaque fenêtre Windows peut être placée: Each Windows window can be placed on the screen of your choice, like a Linux window, and an app can open on the same screen every time. If Windows windows look wrong (blurry, shifted or misplaced) after a screen change, the "Reset displays" command, available in the panel indicator and in the companion app, redraws these windows.
L'icône de Vasistas dans le panneau, en: The Vasistas icon in the panel, at the top of the screen, shows the state of Windows (running, asleep, shut down) and gives access to everyday actions: open an app, reset displays, put Windows to sleep or shut it down, open Vasistas.
Le presse-papiers est partagé entre Linu: The clipboard is shared between Linux and Windows: text, formatted text and images copied in one can be pasted in the other.
Les raccourcis clavier sont transmis à l: Keyboard shortcuts are sent to the active Windows window (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+S, Alt+Tab in an app…). The Super key stays reserved for the Linux desktop.
Un point de restauration enregistre l'ét: A restore point records the state of the whole Windows disk. Create one in the Restore tab before a risky change. If you tick the option, Vasistas also creates a restore point automatically before Windows Update and before installing an app, and keeps the last three automatic points; restore points created manually are kept until you delete them. If Windows no longer works properly after a change, go back to the restore point created before that change. Changes made in Windows since that point are lost, but not your files in the shared folders (Documents, Downloads…), which stay on Linux. Each restore point takes up disk space.
Vos applications Windows sont dans le me: Your Windows apps are in the Applications menu, alongside your other apps. Click an app: Windows starts automatically if needed, then the window opens on your desktop, with its icon in the dock. Double-clicking a Word or Excel document also opens that document in Windows.
L'icône de Vasistas dans le panneau indi: The Vasistas icon in the panel shows whether Windows is running or asleep. If a window looks wrong after a screen change, choose “Reset displays” from this icon's menu: Vasistas redraws the windows without closing your apps.
Vous découvrez Vasistas ? La visite guid: New to Vasistas? The guided tour presents the main features in four screens.
Un double-clic sur un document Word, Exc: Double-clicking a Word, Excel, PowerPoint or Power BI document in the Files app opens that document in the matching Windows app. In Vasistas, the Files page, "Open with Windows" tab, sets which file types are affected.
Windows affiche vos dossiers Linux Docum: Windows shows your Linux Documents and Downloads folders as drives, named "Documents (Linux)" and "Downloads (Linux)". Documents saved on these drives are available from Linux. The Files page of Vasistas lets you share other folders and link the Windows folders (Documents, Pictures…) to the matching Linux folders. For a file located outside the shared folders, Vasistas offers to open a copy.
Lorsqu'aucune fenêtre Windows n'est util: When no Windows window has been used for a while, Windows goes to sleep automatically and frees the computer's resources; Windows wakes up on the first click. The Vasistas Home page lets you put Windows to sleep, shut it down or restart it. The Display page sets the sleep delays and, in its advanced options, the detailed settings.
Windows n'installe pas ses mises à jour: Windows does not install its updates while you work: run Windows Update from the Windows page of Vasistas about once a month. Vasistas checks for its own new versions automatically; the “Check now” button on the Preferences page starts an immediate check.
La page Aide et diagnostic vérifie ce do: The Help and diagnostics page checks what Vasistas needs: virtualization, packages, disk space, memory, the connection with Windows, shared folders, sound, menu launchers. A “Fix” button appears when Vasistas can fix the problem automatically. The “Copy Report” button prepares a text with no personal data (no name, no password, no file names) to attach to a problem report.
Si une fenêtre Windows a disparu, rouvre: If a Windows window has disappeared, reopen the app from the Applications menu. If Windows no longer responds, choose “Restart” in the Windows card on the Home page. If a shared drive stops responding, Vasistas reconnects it automatically within a minute. Diagnostics (Help and diagnostics page) looks for the cause of a problem and offers a fix. Problems can be reported at {url}.
Windows voit vos dossiers Documents et T: Windows sees your Linux Documents and Downloads folders as drives. Documents saved in these folders stay stored on Linux, even if Windows is reverted to a restore point. The Files page lets you share other folders with Windows.
Chaque page de Vasistas a un bouton « ?: Each Vasistas page has a “?” button that opens the guide at the matching section (F1 opens the full guide). If a problem occurs, the diagnostics (Help and diagnostics page) look for the cause, fix what can be fixed and prepare a report without personal data to report the problem.
